blocks.text: Yeh Unit 12 (Limit and Continuity) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Evaluate (i) \(\lim_{x \to 3}\frac{x^{2} - x - 6}{x^{2} - 9}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 5}\frac{x - 5}{\sqrt{x + 4} - 3}\). (5 marks)
(Nikalein: (i) \(\lim_{x \to 3}\frac{x^{2} - x - 6}{x^{2} - 9}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 5}\frac{x - 5}{\sqrt{x + 4} - 3}\).)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein \(\frac{0}{0}\): (i) mein factors, (ii) mein denominator ko rationalize karein.

book_ref.quote: We simplify the given function by using the algebraic technique of making factors

steps: (ii) \(x = 5\) par: \(\frac{0}{\sqrt{9} - 3} = \frac{0}{0}\). Upar neeche \(\sqrt{x + 4} + 3\) se zarb dein.

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove that \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\) when \(n\) is a positive integer. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke jab \(n\) positive integer ho to \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\).)
blocks.explanation: Rakhne se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai; \(x^{n} - a^{n}\) ke factors banayein, \(x - a\) cancel karein, phir rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Suppose \(n\) is a positive integer.

steps: \(x = a\) rakhne se \(\frac{a^{n} - a^{n}}{a - a} = \frac{0}{0}\), is liye factors banate hain.
\(x^{n} - a^{n} = (x - a)\left(x^{n-1} + ax^{n-2} + a^{2}x^{n-3} + \dots + a^{n-1}\right)\), bracket mein \(n\) terms.
\(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = \lim_{x \to a}\left(x^{n-1} + ax^{n-2} + \dots + a^{n-1}\right)\), \(x - a \ne 0\) cancel karke.
\(x = a\) rakhne se: \(a^{n-1} + a\cdot a^{n-2} + a^{2}a^{n-3} + \dots + a^{n-1}\).
Har term \(a^{n-1}\) hai (powers ka jor \(n - 1\)), aur \(n\) terms hain: majmooa \(na^{n-1}\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\) when \(n\) is a negative integer (\(a > 0\)). Use the result for positive integers. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke jab \(n\) negative integer ho (\(a > 0\)) to \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\). Positive integers wala natija istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(n = -m\) rakhein (\(m\) positive integer), positive powers mein likhein aur Case 1 istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: where \(m\) is a positive integer

steps: \(\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = \frac{\frac{1}{x^{m}} - \frac{1}{a^{m}}}{x - a} = \frac{a^{m} - x^{m}}{x^{m}a^{m}(x - a)} = \left(\frac{-1}{x^{m}a^{m}}\right)\left(\frac{x^{m} - a^{m}}{x - a}\right)\)
\(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = \lim_{x \to a}\left(\frac{-1}{x^{m}a^{m}}\right)\cdot\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{m} - a^{m}}{x - a}\) (product ki limit)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: har negative integer \(n\) ke liye bhi \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{n} - a^{n}}{x - a} = na^{n-1}\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Prove that \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x + a} - \sqrt{a}}{x} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{a}}\), \(a > 0\). Hence evaluate \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x + 25} - 5}{x}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x + a} - \sqrt{a}}{x} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{a}}\), \(a > 0\). Phir \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x + 25} - 5}{x}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Square roots ki wajah se \(\frac{0}{0}\): numerator ko conjugate \(\sqrt{x + a} + \sqrt{a}\) se rationalize karein.

book_ref.quote: so rationalizing the numerator

steps: \(\frac{\sqrt{x + a} - \sqrt{a}}{x}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{x + a} + \sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{x + a} + \sqrt{a}} = \frac{(x + a) - a}{x\left(\sqrt{x + a} + \sqrt{a}\right)} = \frac{x}{x\left(\sqrt{x + a} + \sqrt{a}\right)}\)
Doosri limit mein \(5 = \sqrt{25}\), yani \(a = 25\) wali shakal.

blocks.prompt:
5 Prove from the definition that the sequence \(a_{n} = \frac{3}{n}\) converges to \(0\). Find a suitable \(N\) when \(\varepsilon = 0.001\). (5 marks)
(Definition se saabit karein ke sequence \(a_{n} = \frac{3}{n}\), \(0\) ki taraf converge karti hai. \(\varepsilon = 0.001\) ke liye munasib \(N\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har \(\varepsilon > 0\) ke liye sirf \(\varepsilon\) par munhasir position \(N\) dhoondein jis ke baad \(|a_{n} - 0| < \varepsilon\).

book_ref.quote: for any arbitrarily small positive number

steps: \(\frac{3}{n} < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow n > \frac{3}{\varepsilon}\); is liye aisa positive integer \(N \ge \frac{3}{\varepsilon}\) chunein.
Yeh har \(\varepsilon > 0\) ke liye durust hai, is liye definition se \(\lim_{n \to \infty}\frac{3}{n} = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the limits of the sequences, if they exist: (i) \(a_{n} = \frac{n^{2} + 3n}{4n^{2} - 1}\) (ii) \(b_{n} = \frac{(-1)^{n}\,n}{n + 1}\) (look at the even and odd terms). (5 marks)
(Sequences ki limits nikalein agar maujood hon: (i) \(a_{n} = \frac{n^{2} + 3n}{4n^{2} - 1}\) (ii) \(b_{n} = \frac{(-1)^{n}\,n}{n + 1}\) (juft aur taaq terms dekhein).)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(n^{2}\) common lein aur \(\frac{a}{n^{p}} \to 0\) istemal karein. (ii) Dekhein ke terms aik qeemat ke qareeb tehartin ya nahi.

book_ref.quote: Find the limit of the sequence

steps: Terms \(1\) aur \(-1\) ke qareeb qeematon ke darmiyan jhoolti rehti hain, aik qeemat par nahi tehartin, is liye \(\{b_{n}\}\) diverge karti hai.
blocks.final_answer: (i) \(\frac{1}{4}\) (ii) limit maujood nahi (sequence jhoolne ki wajah se diverge karti hai)

blocks.prompt:
7 Evaluate (i) \(\lim_{x \to +\infty}\frac{3x^{3} - 2x + 1}{6x^{3} + x^{2} - 4}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to -\infty}\frac{2x^{4} + x}{-x^{3} + 5}\). (5 marks)
(Nikalein: (i) \(\lim_{x \to +\infty}\frac{3x^{3} - 2x + 1}{6x^{3} + x^{2} - 4}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to -\infty}\frac{2x^{4} + x}{-x^{3} + 5}\).)
blocks.explanation: Har term ko denominator ki sab se bari power (dono mein \(x^{3}\)) se taqseem karein, phir \(\frac{a}{x^{p}} \to 0\).

book_ref.quote: In this case we first divide each term of both the numerator and the denominator

steps: \(x \to -\infty\) par: \(\frac{1}{x^{2}} \to 0\), \(\frac{5}{x^{3}} \to 0\), denominator \(\to -1\), aur \(2x\) manfi hai aur size mein beghair had barhta hai.
Bohat bara manfi number \(-1\) se taqseem ho to bohat bara musbat number banta hai, is liye limit \(+\infty\) (jaanch: \(x = -100\) par taqreeban \(1.9999 \times 10^{2}\)).

blocks.prompt:
8 Evaluate (i) \(\lim_{x \to +\infty}\frac{5x - 2}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4x}}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to -\infty}\frac{5x - 2}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4x}}\). (5 marks)
(Nikalein: (i) \(\lim_{x \to +\infty}\frac{5x - 2}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4x}}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to -\infty}\frac{5x - 2}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 4x}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Denominator \(\sqrt{x^{2}} = |x|\) jaisa hai: \(x > 0\) par \(x\) se, \(x < 0\) par \(-x\) se taqseem karein.
steps: (i) \(x > 0\) par \(\sqrt{x^{2}} = x\). Upar neeche \(x\) se taqseem: \(\frac{5 - \frac{2}{x}}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{4}{x}}}\).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Dhyan dein: \(x \to -\infty\) par \(\sqrt{x^{2}} = -x\) likhna hi jawab ka sign tay karta hai. Agar ghalti se \(\sqrt{x^{2}} = x\) likh dein to (ii) ka jawab bhi \(5\) aa jayega, jo ghalat hai: \(x = -1000\) par qeemat taqreeban \(-5\) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Show that \(\lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = e\), and deduce that \(\lim_{x \to 0}(1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = e\), aur is se natija nikalein ke \(\lim_{x \to 0}(1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\).)
blocks.explanation: Binomial theorem se phelayein, har term mein \(n \to \infty\) karein, phir \(n = \frac{1}{x}\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: By the binomial theorem, we have

steps: \(n = \frac{1}{x}\) rakhein: \(\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\), aur \(n \to \infty\) par \(x \to 0\); is liye \(\lim_{x \to 0}(1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = e \approx 2.718281\) aur \(\lim_{x \to 0}(1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\).

blocks.prompt:
10 Express each limit in terms of \(e\): (i) \(\lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1 + \frac{5}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 0}\left(1 + \frac{x}{3}\right)^{\frac{2}{x}}\). (5 marks)
(Har limit ko \(e\) ki shakal mein likhein: (i) \(\lim_{n \to +\infty}\left(1 + \frac{5}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 0}\left(1 + \frac{x}{3}\right)^{\frac{2}{x}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Power ko aise torein ke \(\left(1 + \frac{1}{m}\right)^{m}\) (\(m \to \infty\)) ya \((1 + m)^{\frac{1}{m}}\) (\(m \to 0\)) ban jaye.

book_ref.quote: Put \(n = \frac{1}{x}\) in (i), then

blocks.prompt:
11 Prove that \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{a^{x} - 1}{x} = \log_{e} a\) (\(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\)), and deduce \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{e^{x} - 1}{x}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{a^{x} - 1}{x} = \log_{e} a\) (\(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\)), aur is se \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{e^{x} - 1}{x}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = a^{x} - 1\) se variable badlein taake \(\lim_{y \to 0}(1 + y)^{\frac{1}{y}} = e\) samne aa jaye.

book_ref.quote: From (i), when \(x \to 0\), \(y \to 0\).

steps: \(a^{x} - 1 = y\) rakhein; phir \(a^{x} = 1 + y\) aur \(x = \log_{a}(1 + y)\). \(x \to 0\) par \(a^{x} \to 1\), is liye \(y \to 0\).
\(= \lim_{y \to 0}\frac{1}{\log_{a}(1 + y)^{\frac{1}{y}}} = \frac{1}{\log_{a} e}\) (kyunke \((1 + y)^{\frac{1}{y}} \to e\); log ka qaida \(k\log N = \log N^{k}\))
Change of base se \(\log_{a} e = \frac{1}{\log_{e} a}\), is liye \(\frac{1}{\log_{a} e} = \log_{e} a\).

blocks.prompt:
12 State the Sandwich Theorem and use it to show that \(\lim_{x \to 0} x\sin\frac{1}{x} = 0\). (5 marks)
(Sandwich Theorem bayan karein aur is se dikhayein ke \(\lim_{x \to 0} x\sin\frac{1}{x} = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x\sin\frac{1}{x}\) ko do aasaan functions ke darmiyan qaid karein jin ki limit \(0\) ho.

book_ref.quote: Many limit problems arise that cannot be directly evaluated by algebraic techniques.

steps: Theorem: agar \(c\) wale open interval mein (shayad \(c\) ke ilawa) tamam \(x\) ke liye \(f(x) \le g(x) \le h(x)\) aur \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c} h(x) = L\) ho to \(\lim_{x \to c} g(x) = L\).
Rakhna kaam nahi karta: \(\sin\frac{1}{x}\), \(x = 0\) par defined nahi, aur \(\lim_{x \to 0}\sin\frac{1}{x}\) maujood nahi, is liye product wala qaida nahi lag sakta.
\(x \ne 0\) ke liye: \(\left|\sin\frac{1}{x}\right| \le 1\), is liye \(\left|x\sin\frac{1}{x}\right| \le |x|\), yani \(-|x| \le x\sin\frac{1}{x} \le |x|\).

blocks.prompt:
13 If \(\theta\) is measured in radian, prove that \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\theta\) radian mein ho to saabit karein ke \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1\).)
blocks.explanation: Unit circle mein \(\Delta OAB\), sector \(OAB\) aur \(\Delta OAD\) ke areas ka muqabla karein, phir Sandwich Theorem lagayein.

book_ref.quote: From the figure we see that Area of

steps: \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\) ko radius \(1\) wale circle ka markazi zaviya lein; \(|OA| = |OB| = 1\), \(BC \perp OA\), \(AD \perp OA\) aur \(D\), \(OB\) ki barhai hui line par: \(|BC| = \sin\theta\), \(|AD| = \tan\theta\).
\(\Delta OAB\) ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}\sin\theta\); sector \(OAB\) ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta = \frac{\theta}{2}\); \(\Delta OAD\) ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}\tan\theta\).
\(\Delta OAB\) sector ke andar, sector \(\Delta OAD\) ke andar: \(\frac{1}{2}\sin\theta < \frac{\theta}{2} < \frac{1}{2}\tan\theta\).

\(\theta \to 0\) par \(\cos\theta \to 1\); \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\), \(\cos\theta\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan daba hua hai, is liye \(1\) ki taraf jata hai. \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < 0\) ke liye \(\frac{\sin(-\theta)}{-\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\), wahi natija.

blocks.prompt:
14 Evaluate (i) \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{\theta\sin\theta}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\tan x - \sin x}{x^{3}}\). (5 marks)
(Nikalein: (i) \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{\theta\sin\theta}\) (ii) \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\tan x - \sin x}{x^{3}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Dono \(\frac{0}{0}\) hain. Conjugate se \(1 - \cos\) ko \(\sin^{2}\) banayein, phir \(\frac{\sin u}{u}\) banayein.

book_ref.quote: When \(\theta \to 0\), \(\cos\theta \to 1\).

steps: (ii) \(\tan x - \sin x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} - \sin x = \frac{\sin x\,(1 - \cos x)}{\cos x}\).

\(\frac{\tan x - \sin x}{x^{3}} = \frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot\frac{1 - \cos x}{x^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{\cos x} = \frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot\left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^{2}\cdot\frac{1}{1 + \cos x}\cdot\frac{1}{\cos x}\) (\(1 - \cos x = \frac{\sin^{2} x}{1 + \cos x}\))

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: (ii) mein \(\lim \tan x - \lim \sin x = 0 - 0\) likh kar ruk jana ghalat hai, kyunke denominator \(x^{3}\) bhi \(0\) ki taraf jata hai. Pehle common factor \(\sin x\) nikalein aur \(1 - \cos x\) ko \(1 + \cos x\) se zarb de kar \(\sin^{2} x\) banayein.

blocks.prompt:
15 Determine whether \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) and \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) exist, where \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) for \(0 \le x \le 1\), \(f(x) = 3x - 1\) for \(1 < x < 3\), and \(f(x) = x + 4\) for \(3 \le x \le 5\). (5 marks)
(Maloom karein ke \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) aur \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) maujood hain ya nahi, jahan \(0 \le x \le 1\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\), \(1 < x < 3\) par \(f(x) = 3x - 1\), aur \(3 \le x \le 5\) par \(f(x) = x + 4\).)
blocks.explanation: Har jor wale nuqte par sahi hisse se left aur right hand limits nikalein aur muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: Determine whether \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) and \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist, when

steps: \(x = 1\) par daen taraf (\(1 < x < 3\)): \(\lim_{x \to 1^{+}}(3x - 1) = 3 - 1 = 2\). Barabar, is liye \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = 2\).
\(8 \ne 7\), is liye criterion se \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) maujood nahi (halanke \(f(3) = 7\) defined hai).
blocks.final_answer: \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = 2\) maujood hai; \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) maujood nahi (LHL \(8\), RHL \(7\)).

blocks.prompt:
16 Discuss the continuity of \(f\) at \(x = 0\) and at \(x = 2\), where \(f(x) = 2x + 1\) for \(x \le 0\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) for \(0 < x < 2\), and \(f(x) = 4x - 2\) for \(x \ge 2\). (5 marks)
(\(x = 0\) aur \(x = 2\) par \(f\) ki continuity par behas karein, jahan \(x \le 0\) par \(f(x) = 2x + 1\), \(0 < x < 2\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\), aur \(x \ge 2\) par \(f(x) = 4x - 2\).)
blocks.explanation: Har nuqte par jaanchein: (i) \(f(c)\) defined, (ii) limit maujood (LHL \(=\) RHL), (iii) limit \(= f(c)\).

book_ref.quote: Discuss continuity of \(f(x)\) at \(x = 3\), when

steps: \(5 \ne 6\): \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) maujood nahi, shart (ii) poori nahi, is liye \(f\), \(x = 2\) par discontinuous hai (chhalang, jump).
blocks.final_answer: \(f\), \(x = 0\) par continuous aur \(x = 2\) par discontinuous hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Find \(m\) and \(n\) so that \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 2\), where \(f(x) = mx + 1\) for \(x < 2\), \(f(2) = n\), and \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\) for \(x > 2\). (5 marks)
(\(m\) aur \(n\) maloom karein taake \(f\), \(x = 2\) par continuous ho, jahan \(x < 2\) par \(f(x) = mx + 1\), \(f(2) = n\), aur \(x > 2\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\).)
blocks.explanation: Continuity ke liye LHL \(=\) RHL \(= f(2)\); maloom hissa mushtarka qeemat tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: if and only if the following three conditions are satisfied

steps: Limit maujood hone ke liye: \(2m + 1 = 7 \Rightarrow m = 3\); phir \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x) = 7\).
Jaanch: \(m = 3\), \(n = 7\) ke saath LHL \(= 3(2) + 1 = 7\), RHL \(= 7\), \(f(2) = 7\); teeno sharaait poori.

blocks.prompt:
18 Find \(k\) so that \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 3\), where \(f(x) = \frac{\sqrt{x + 6} - 3}{x - 3}\) for \(x \ne 3\) and \(f(3) = k\). (5 marks)
(\(k\) maloom karein taake \(f\), \(x = 3\) par continuous ho, jahan \(x \ne 3\) par \(f(x) = \frac{\sqrt{x + 6} - 3}{x - 3}\) aur \(f(3) = k\).)
blocks.explanation: \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) nikalein (\(\frac{0}{0}\) form; rationalize) aur use \(f(3) = k\) ke barabar rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Discuss the continuity of the functions

steps: \(x = 3\) par: \(\frac{\sqrt{9} - 3}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\). Upar neeche \(\sqrt{x + 6} + 3\) se zarb dein.
\(k = \frac{1}{6}\) ke saath \(f(3)\) defined, limit maujood aur dono barabar: \(f\), \(x = 3\) par continuous hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 A population is modelled by \(P(t) = \frac{5000}{1 + 4e^{-0.2t}}\), \(t\) in years. Find (i) the initial population (ii) \(P(10)\) correct to the nearest whole number (iii) the long-term population \(\lim_{t \to \infty} P(t)\). (5 marks)
(Aabadi \(P(t) = \frac{5000}{1 + 4e^{-0.2t}}\) se zahir hai, \(t\) saalon mein. Nikalein: (i) shuru ki aabadi (ii) \(P(10)\) qareeb tareen poore number tak (iii) lambe arse ki aabadi \(\lim_{t \to \infty} P(t)\).)
blocks.explanation: \(t = 0\) aur \(t = 10\) rakhein; lambe arse ke liye \(t \to \infty\) par \(e^{-kt} \to 0\) (\(k > 0\)).

book_ref.quote: These concepts help us model, analyze and solve problems in various fields

blocks.final_answer: (i) \(1000\) (ii) taqreeban \(3244\) (iii) \(5000\): aabadi \(5000\) ki taraf barhti hai magar us se aage nahi jati.

blocks.prompt:
20 A factory's cost function is \(C(x) = 15x + 400\) for \(x \le 200\) and \(C(x) = 12x + k\) for \(x > 200\). Find \(k\) so that \(C\) is continuous at \(x = 200\), and then find \(C(250)\). (5 marks)
(Factory ka cost function \(x \le 200\) par \(C(x) = 15x + 400\) aur \(x > 200\) par \(C(x) = 12x + k\) hai. \(k\) maloom karein taake \(C\), \(x = 200\) par continuous ho, phir \(C(250)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(200\) par continuity: \(C(200) =\) LHL \(=\) RHL.

book_ref.quote: Limit and continuity of transcendental functions are fundamental concepts in calculus

steps: Continuity ke liye \(2400 + k = 3400\), is liye \(k = 1000\).
Phir \(\lim_{x \to 200} C(x) = 3400 = C(200)\): teeno sharaait poori.
